name: Ajmal Kasab
real_life_parallel: Real Ajmal Kasab — only 26/11 attacker captured alive; executed 21 Nov 2012

biography.background: Only 26/11 attacker captured alive. Pakistani national from Punjab village. Joined LeT seeking money/identity; became suicide attacker. Captured at Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus after killing spree.
biography.capture: Photographed alive with weapon; provided initial confession; trial in India
biography.execution: 21 November 2012, Yerwada Jail, Pune — hanged in secret; buried on jail premises

risk_profile.description: Willing martyr; high indoctrination; minimal survival instinct

adversary_model.capture_value: Revealed Pakistani origins; LeT training; confessed operational details
